youtube.description:
6 Kiro hook triggers beyond file save

Six Kiro hook triggers you are probably not using.

1. Prompt submit - Fires when you send a prompt.
2. Agent stop - Fires when the agent finishes.
3. Session start - Fires when a session begins.
4. Pre tool use - Fires before a tool runs.
5. Post tool use - Fires right after a tool runs.
6. Task execution - Fires around each spec task.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types/
